title: Refine publication doctrine from explicit Monitoring review rationales
description: Implement and verify private database-driven editorial context for publication and section scopes. Preserve current publication guidance, selected-desk additions and rule overrides, authorization boundaries, source revisions and effective-context hashes. Connect current context to classification and copy-edit prompt constructors; reject denied, missing, ambiguous, mismatched or stale required context before provider transmission. Tests and public records use synthetic policy text only. Real publication prose and human rationale stay private outside Git or in authenticated database records. Production writes, grants, deployments and live model calls remain separately gated.
